content.title: Next James Bond Reportedly Chosen - IMDb
content.text: Next James Bond Reportedly ChosenAaron Taylor-Johnson has reportedly been offered the role of James Bond, though he has not yet accepted. Eon and franchise producers have not yet officially confirmed whether Taylor-Johnson has been offered the role. Daniel Craig was the most recent actor to play 007, exiting the franchise in 2021 with No Time To Die.New reports claim that the next James Bond actor has now been chosen. Based on the character created by Ian Fleming, Bond has now been played by a handful of actors over the past 60 years. Daniel Craig was the latest star to take on the part, but he bid farewell to 007 with 2021's No Time To Die, and there's been no official word since regarding who will take his place as the iconic British spy.Now, The Sun reports that actor Aaron Taylor-Johnson has been chosen as the next actor to play Bond.
